description:
Card Package
Widget which lets you add membership card in Shelf.
You enter numbers for a club card or something and it'll store it and generate a barcode for you.
Shelf is a page on your home screen that allows you to take memos, add widgets, gain access to your most-used apps, and get a quick glimpse of the weather. Swipe right (from the left edge of your home screen) to reveal it.
